name: ch-company-formation
description: Company formation and entity choice in Switzerland for tax year 2026, from the Code of Obligations (OR), the Commercial Register Ordinance (HRegV) and the fee ordinance (GebV-HReg). Covers the GmbH/Sarl (CHF 20,000 capital, fully paid in) and the AG/SA (CHF 100,000, at least 20% of each share and CHF 50,000 paid in), sole proprietorships and partnerships, the public deed and the blocked capital account, the Swiss-resident representative, the commercial register fees (CHF 420 for a company, CHF 160 for a partnership, CHF 80 for a sole proprietorship), the 1% issuance stamp duty above CHF 1 million, the CHF 100,000 VAT threshold, bookkeeping, the Zurich notary fee, the six-month approval deadline and the audit thresholds. Trigger phrases: GmbH gründen, AG Gründung, Stammkapital, Aktienkapital, Handelsregister Gebühren, Emissionsabgabe, opting-out. Out of scope (go to the sibling): ch-corporate-income-tax, ch-cantonal-tax, switzerland-vat, ch-ahv-iv, ch-tax-overview.
